ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Delia is joining three vertices of a square to make four right-angled triangles.
She can create four triangles doing this, as shown.
<image1>
How many right-angled triangles can Delia make by joining three vertices of a regular polygon with 18 sides?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is the outline of a square; on the right side are shown four gray right triangles, which correspond to the four triangles formed by choosing any three vertices from the four vertices of the square. Each gray triangle has one right angle, indicating that the problem is counting right triangles composed of three vertices of a regular polygon. Reasoning: Generalize the square to a regular 18-gon. All vertices of the regular 18-gon lie on the same circumcircle. By the inscribed angle theorem, an inscribed triangle is a right triangle if and only if one of its sides is a diameter of the circumcircle, that is, the hypotenuse of the triangle connects a pair of opposite vertices. A regular 18-gon has 18 vertices, so the number of pairs of opposite vertices is 18 ÷ 2 = 9. For each diameter, the third vertex can be chosen arbitrarily from the remaining 18 - 2 = 16 vertices. Each right triangle will be counted only once by its unique hypotenuse diameter. So the total number is 9 × 16 = 144.

raw_record.question_text:
Delia is joining three vertices of a square to make four right-angled triangles, as shown.
How many right-angled triangles can Delia make by joining three vertices of a regular polygon with 18 sides?

method.method_draft: First read the image: it shows a square and the four possible triangles obtained by choosing any three of its four vertices; each shaded triangle is right-angled, illustrating that Delia is counting triples of polygon vertices that form right triangles. From the text, replace the square by a regular polygon with 18 sides. Use the theorem that an inscribed triangle is right-angled exactly when one of its sides is a diameter of the circumcircle. In a regular 18-gon, opposite vertex pairs form diameters; there are 18/2 = 9 such pairs. For each diameter, the third vertex can be any of the remaining 18 - 2 = 16 vertices. Each right triangle is counted once because its hypotenuse is the unique diameter side. Therefore the number is 9 × 16 = 144.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个正方形轮廓；右侧显示了四个灰色直角三角形，它们对应于从正方形的四个顶点中任取三个顶点所形成的四个三角形。每个灰色三角形都有一个直角，说明题目是在数由正多边形顶点三点组成的直角三角形。推理：把正方形推广到正18边形。正18边形的所有顶点都在同一个外接圆上。由圆周角定理，一个内接三角形是直角三角形，当且仅当它的一条边是外接圆的直径，也就是三角形的斜边连接一对相对顶点。正18边形有18个顶点，因此相对顶点对数为18 ÷ 2 = 9。对每一条直径，第三个顶点可以从剩下的18 - 2 = 16个顶点中任选。每个直角三角形只会被其唯一的斜边直径计数一次。所以总数是9 × 16 = 144。
